claim: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC (any non-empty value, including 0/false) disables auto-updates, telemetry, error reporting, /feedback, release notes, PR status badges, availability checks and feature-flag fetching; it does not cover official plugin marketplace auto-install (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_OFFICIAL_MARKETPLACE_AUTOINSTALL) or the WebFetch check. DISABLE_TELEMETRY and DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING also treat 0/false as opt-out; DO_NOT_TRACK is a standard boolean.
label: from-official-docs

claim: Built-in starting permission mode: interactive terminal and VS Code sessions start in auto on v2.1.283+; claude -p / Agent SDK start in default when the session fetches feature flags, and in auto (v2.1.285+) when it does not (third-party provider or telemetry off); when auto is unavailable (unsupported model, disableAutoMode, server-side off) the session starts in Manual (default). Corrects profile default_mode.
label: from-official-docs

claim: On Linux and macOS Claude Code refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions when run as root or under sudo ('cannot be used with root/sudo privileges for security reasons'); the check is skipped inside a 'recognized sandbox' (mechanism not documented; IS_SANDBOX does not appear in the env-var reference or CHANGELOG as of 2026-10-15). The dev container runs Claude Code as a non-root user.
label: from-official-docs

claim: What runs in a never-trusted folder under claude -p / SDK: settings hooks, env block, apiKeyHelper and project skill hooks/allowed-tools are used; permissions.allow and additionalDirectories are not used (stderr 'this workspace has not been trusted'); project subagent frontmatter hooks, inline subagent mcpServers and repo extraKnownMarketplaces are not used; .mcp.json servers connect without asking; .mcp.json headersHelper is not run (stderr 'headersHelper not run'). With only a parent folder trusted, settings hooks and env are used.
